portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint: bespoke ASP.NET WebForms search (__VIEWSTATE, __EVENTVALIDATION, no vendor signature); documents host fingerprinted as Civica by its inline Civica.APIUrl bootstrap

document_host.note: A 'Civica Town - Planning Documents' shell. Its bootstrap gives Civica.APIUrl = /w2webparts/Resource/Civica/Handler.ashx/ and PlanningApplicationRefType = GFPlanning, and its inline script searches on the field SDescription (the human reference). The JSON API can be called directly with the reference; the search portal is not needed.

committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26. Older expired committees (Development Control Committee 158, Planning & Environment Committee 166) hold historic papers. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: YYYY/N with an unpadded serial and no type suffix. Condition discharges add a suffix, e.g. 2026/554/Cond1.

bot_protection.behaviour: The search form on tdcplanningsearch.tandridge.gov.uk will not submit without a completed reCAPTCHA (checked client-side and on the postback).

browser_route.note: URL-encode the reference (/ as %2F). For searching by address, use https://tdcplanningsearch.tandridge.gov.uk/ in a browser.

endpoints.note: (1) POST pagedsearch with JSON {"refType":"GFPlanning","fromRow":1,"toRow":10,"searchFields":{"SDescription":"<REF>"}} -> KeyObjects[0].KeyNumber, TotalRows 1. (2) POST doc/list with JSON {"KeyNumb":<KeyNumber>,"KeyText":"Subject","RefType":"GFPlanning","ProcessNo":"","PageSize":50} -> CompleteDocument[] and RowCount. (3) GET pagestream.

quirks.summary: The register's own search is reCAPTCHA-gated, so a reference or address search cannot be scripted there.
quirks.detail: The documents host is keyed by the human reference and is not gated, so retrieval from a known reference does not touch the search portal. Discovering a reference from an address still needs a browser.
quirks.workaround: Take the reference from the user (or PlanIt's docs_url, which is the documents-host link) and go straight to the Civica API.

quirks.summary: The pagedsearch response includes the applicant's name in its field list.
quirks.workaround: Use only KeyNumber from the search response; do not store the other fields.

pacing.note: Six requests to the two hosts at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26, no 429 or challenge on the documents host.

robots.note: No robots.txt on either host (404 on tdcplanningsearch and on plandocs).

verification.note: Search portal fingerprinted as bespoke WebForms with a reCAPTCHA-gated search, which was not attempted. PlanIt's applics docs_url pointed at the Civica documents host. Recipe B there on 2026/836: pagedsearch on SDescription -> TotalRows 1, KeyNumber -> doc/list RowCount 9 (9 rows) -> pagestream download of the decision notice: application/pdf, %PDF-1.7 magic bytes. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee id. Content check on a full download: 239,567 bytes, 3 pages with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice.
